_readme: The Treasury's register of every registered condominium (อาคารชุด) in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai, with the ASSESSED value per square metre. ราคาประเมิน is the figure transfer fees and taxes are reckoned from — it is NOT a market price, not an asking price, and not what anyone paid, and it is normally well below all three. Anything rendered from this file must say so. A building carries one row per use category and floor band, so its figure is a SPREAD (assessed_low–assessed_high), never a single welded number — the make_shelf_cards price lesson. Owned wholesale by importers/harvest_condo_register.py; nothing else may write it. Traps, both measured 2026-08-21: the source CSV is cp874, not UTF-8 (read as UTF-8 it silently yields ZERO northern rows), and the north sits at the END of a 122,112-row national file, so any size-capped read returns a file with no Chiang Mai in it.
